limitations: Single fixed seed0 model/planner configuration; no objective/horizon/noise/weight sweep.
Nominal simulation; model trained under recorded actions, planner changes action/state visitation.
Hand-designed terminal cost and short0.4s horizon; no uncertainty or learned reward.
Only selected-action OOD diagnostics; within per-axis action95% does not guarantee sequence/state in distribution.
Realized-action-prefix prediction check uses fixed first3 episodes per task, not original selected future-sequence accuracy.
Success alone does not prove useful model causality; no counterfactual model ablation and no learned policy/planning optimization.
Ordinary yaw-error differences retain existing representation; wrap branch-cut crossings may inflate RMSE. Realized-prefix sanity is not a geodesic yaw metric nor all-episode forecast estimate.

research_assessment.result: Negative fixed-configuration finding: MPC benchmark0/100, holdout1/100; scripted100/100 in both. MPC final distance and physical safety worse than even zero command.
research_assessment.model_exploitation: 85.96% selected commands exceed at least one coordinatewise Train95% interval; substantial realized-prefix forecast mismatch. Compatible with action/state OOD and model exploitation risk, not a causal demonstration or unique explanation.
research_assessment.heuristic_reality_check: Commands are highly time-varying, not constant/zero or scripted proportional equivalence. Initial target-direction correlations x/y/z0.182/0.051/0.284 are weak; no decision usefulness inferred from this check.
research_assessment.real_time: All44229 observed CPU planning and totaldecision times below40ms; not an OS real-time guarantee.
research_assessment.completion_time_caveat: MPC1.24s is from only1 success; not comparable evidence of faster completion versus100 scripted successes per split.
research_assessment.crossing_caveat: Low crossing fraction largely accompanies failure to enter/finish near-target region; not evidence of stable braking.
research_assessment.next_single_recommendation: A separately authorized paired action-support constraint control with same frozen model/N/H/cost, comparing Train-supported candidate bounds against current environment-bound sampling; do not execute here.
